patternScanner.question: Can nonrecursive mode-specific scanner steps shrink checking while lexical tail callbacks preserve original token-first recursion and ownership?
patternScanner.cheapTest: Typed callback native smoke PASS7n; direct nested mode-first original-ABI smoke consumed-binder FAIL, so mode matching lives in nonrecursive helpers with aligned formals
patternScanner.onPass: Actual complete ordinary load/check/codegen then artifact execution/corpus, no trusted-prefix acceptance
patternScanner.onFailure: Report concrete source/toolchain boundary, no unsafe/checker/generator logic workaround
patternScanner.quantities: Original scanner ABI and emitted syntax quantities unchanged; helper sharing is explicit and checked
patternScanner.priority: Original order preserved within disjoint mode constructors; no branch priority changed
